question: **Direction: Choose the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is **"Palour."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The error lies in the word **"Palour."** • The correct spelling is **"Parlour."** • The word refers to a room in a house or establishment where people can sit and relax. (अतिथियों के लिए बैठक) • **Example**: *She led him to the **parlour**__ and asked him to be seated.* • We need to add** "r" **between** "a" **and** "l."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Falcon**: a bird of prey. (शिकारी पक्षी जैसे बाज़, जिसे पालकर शिकार करने का प्रशिक्षण दिया जा सकता है) • **Tailor**: a person who makes or alters clothing. (दर्ज़ी, टेलर) • **Talon**: a sharp claw found on birds and some animals. ((कुछ) पक्षियों का पंजा, चंगुल (जिससे वे अन्‍य पशु-पक्षियों का शिकार करते हैं)) 34:Tdac, The correct answer is **"recognise the threat."**
